title: Chao World: Seasons
summary: The Chao garden from Sonic Adventure 2: Battle, rebuilt as its own game for PS Vita and set across a full year of seasons.
description: It began as the Chao World inside SA2: Battle, pulled out of the main game. Now it's growing into a full game of its own, where every Chao has a personality, a family, dreams and favorite things.
features: Chao World only: no story mode, every character playable
Four seasons, day and night, moon phases, rain and falling sakura petals
Festivals in the lobby and rare Chao
Seasonal Chao Games and tournaments: race, karate and swimming, solo or as a team of three
Photo mode, a Chao Journal, fishing and garden decorating
New places, like the Station Square Garden and the Chao Refuge
Features from Chao World Extended (CWE)
note: A fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA. Sonic Adventure 2, Sonic and Chao are trademarks of SEGA. Seasons runs on data from your own copy of the game; no game files are distributed here.

title: The HVAC Trail
status: Coming soon to the App Store
summary: One American summer. Five techs. 530 miles of service calls between you and Labor Day.
description:
An Oregon Trail style survival game about summer AC calls, written by a working HVAC tech, tech to tech.

At every house, size up the unit and make the call: a band-aid, or doing it right. Between calls, keep your crew hydrated and on their feet in the heat.
features: Diagnose real faults with the data tag, meter, amp clamp and gauges, or an old trick
Play as an owner-operator, senior tech or first-year apprentice
Stock up at three supply houses and paint your own van
Big jobs along the route: a McMansion, a hoarder house, a mobile home park and a lake house rental
Game Center leaderboard and a Hall of Fame
EGA DOS pixel art
Plays offline, no account needed

title: Tinbox
summary: A free GBA, GB and GBC emulator for iPhone. No ads, no accounts, no paid version.
description: A native iPhone emulator with a SwiftUI interface and Metal rendering, running the accurate mGBA core. It plays in portrait or landscape and keeps your library tidy.
features: Save states, rewind and fast-forward
Time Capsule: automatic snapshots of your whole playthrough
Speedrun timer and RetroAchievements
Themes, skins and your own button layout
Bluetooth controllers
Your games and saves stay in plain folders on your phone
screenshotNote: The game shown is Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe, a free homebrew game.
note: Comes with two free homebrew games. Add games you own; Tinbox never downloads any.

title: Ekipad
summary: Turn your iPhone into a game controller for your Mac, over Bluetooth, Wi-Fi or USB.
description:
Ekipad works with Ekipad Host, a free app for your Mac. Games see a standard Xbox controller, so Steam, emulators and native ports work without any setup. For games that only take keyboard and mouse, map any button to a key instead.

The design borrows from Tokyo train signage: each player gets a track number and line colour, and the settings live on a departure board.
features: Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and USB at once, so a dropped link never interrupts play
No router or internet needed
Up to four players
Switches controls automatically for each game
Trackpad mode, with your Mac's screen on the phone if you want it
Move, resize or hide any button
Gyro aiming and rumble
Pair with a click, a QR code or a pictogram code
Ekipad Host updates itself
No ads, no accounts, no tracking
note: Requires iOS 17 and Ekipad Host (free, macOS 14 or later; controller mode needs macOS 15). Ekipad Host is notarized by Apple and comes from GitHub, since the Mac App Store doesn't allow virtual controllers.

title: Packmule
summary: A free file mule for iOS. Haul files between your phone and anything that speaks SMB, FTP or SFTP.
description:
Move files between your phone and Windows shares, NAS boxes, Linux machines and other phones.

Everything is free: no Pro tier, no subscription, no unlock. A file app shouldn't ransom your own files back to you.
features: SMB 2 and 3, FTP and SFTP
Stream movies and music straight from a share, no download first
Jellyfin: sign in, browse and stream
Built-in FTP server, so other devices can connect to your phone
